## Description

Provide a clear and concise summary of the changes introduced in this pull request and the problem they resolve.

## Type of Change

- Bug fix (non-breaking change resolving an existing defect)
- New feature (non-breaking change introducing new capability)
- Breaking change (fix or feature modifying existing API behavior)
- Documentation update (improvements to README, guides, or specifications)
- Performance / optimization (e.g. latency, bandwidth, or session improvements)

## Hardware & Environment Verification

- Target Hardware Model: [e.g. Archer MR200 v5, Archer AX53, Archer C6, or Simulated]
- Firmware Version: [e.g. 1.4.0 0.9.1]
- Operating System: [e.g. Linux 6.8, macOS Sonoma, Windows 11]
- Python Version: [e.g. Python 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13]

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project code style and type annotations.
- [ ] I have executed `python3 -m unittest discover tests` and all unit tests pass.
- [ ] If modifying web portals or schemas, I have run `python3 web/scripts/build.py` successfully.
- [ ] All new and modified documentation is free of decorative emojis and adheres to minimal-readme formatting.
- [ ] No plaintext passwords, auth tokens, or session dumps are committed.
